executed_as: single assistant source and metadata review; no autonomous independent agents were launched
gate: native Windows evidence required before VERIFIED

agents.acceptance: Generate dependency manifest, verify runtime assets and run clean Windows startup without internet.
agents.agent_prompt: Independently review authorized Google Earth installation directory inventory, versions, licenses and dependencies; do not inspect proprietary binaries internally. Identify permitted public architecture clues; report uncertain inferences.

agents.acceptance: Record approved manual menu inventory and automate UI-command => ViewModel => GlobeBridge => readback.
agents.agent_prompt: Observe Google Earth public menus, dialogs, hotkeys and state transitions on an authorized Windows installation. Capture steps/screenshots and interface contracts without copying proprietary resources.

agents.acceptance: Automate 2D/3D transitions, heading/pitch, home/full extent, recovery after invalid camera.
agents.agent_prompt: Use authorized UI interactions to characterize navigation, compass, camera and 2D/3D-related expectations. Record reproducible mouse/keyboard actions, edge cases at poles/dateline and observable results.

agents.acceptance: Run cloud-layer mock test, Windows screenshot test, GPU profiling and reproducible lighting scenarios.
agents.agent_prompt: Use authorized runtime screenshots to describe atmosphere, sunlight, stars, water and cloud behavior; separate visual observations from resource names. Propose legally clean, free Cesium algorithms and benchmark requirements.

agents.acceptance: Export/import fixtures with Unicode, styles, hierarchy, referenced embedded assets and negative KMZ cases.
agents.agent_prompt: Use official OGC/KML documentation and user-owned KML/KMZ fixtures to document Placemark/Folder/StyleMap/NetworkLink/gx:Tour/Overlay semantics, round-trip fidelity, and unsupported cases.

agents.acceptance: Test all Show Grid combinations at poles/dateline and after mode switching; add readback for actual dataSource entity count.
agents.agent_prompt: Document reference grid and coordinate system observable states, including UTM and labels; do not infer behavior from files alone. Preserve ZEarth's additional grid options in handoff.

agents.acceptance: Benchmark offline search, remote timeout and Arabic/English place-name quality; respect provider terms.
agents.agent_prompt: Observe reference search behavior only through permitted UI and public docs; identify service-dependence without extracting endpoints or credentials. Recommend legal offline/free search paths.

agents.role: Reliability, language, flight simulator and data
agents.acceptance: Prioritize reliability first; defer optional flight simulator until user value and independent implementation are reviewed.
agents.agent_prompt: Assess observable startup, failure/restart recovery, settings, localization and public flight-simulator UX where accessible; do not reverse engineer binaries. Rank stability versus optional features.

agents.role: WPF command, ribbon and dialog audit
agents.acceptance: Run GIS UI command audit and enumerate all AutomationId mappings to command implementation, add UI automation evidence.
agents.agent_prompt: Inspect every relevant WPF Ribbon/Menu AutomationId, ICommand and handler; classify missing/bound/engine-acknowledged with source lines and UIA verification requirements.

agents.role: Cesium engine, modes and bridge audit
agents.acceptance: Run node cloud-layer.test.cjs; verify WPF bridge environment.setClouds and environment.cloudsChanged on Windows.
agents.agent_prompt: Inspect CesiumJS/WebView2 command protocol, camera transitions, asynchronous acknowledgements, rendering/effects/cloud toggles and startup synchronization. Recommend fixes and native WebGL acceptance tests.

agents.role: KML, KMZ and Places persistence audit
agents.acceptance: Build fixture catalog, run export/import and XML semantic diff on Windows/.NET, capture unsupported properties.
agents.agent_prompt: Inspect ZEarth KML/KMZ parsing, style preservation, project save/reopen and Temporary/My Places; build safe round-trip cases for Unicode, nested folders, embedded assets and zip-slip/zip-bomb negatives.

agents.role: Grid, sunlight, search and performance audit
agents.acceptance: Instrument visible datasource state; add 2D/3D/pole/grid regression cases; stress 50 toggle cycles and inspect FPS/memory.
agents.agent_prompt: Inspect grids/UTM visibility, polar culling, sunlight/date handling, bilingual/offline search, frame timing and performance. Preserve unique ZEarth interval and north options; prioritize reproducible defects.

execution_contract.dispatch_model: external authorized agent host only; the GitHub Actions matrix is a deterministic evidence probe, NOT an AI-agent launcher
execution_contract.scope: read-only Google Drive reference metadata and allowed public behavior observation for R-roles; GitHub ZEarth source read and separately authorized development branch changes for Z-roles
prohibited: copy Google Earth DLL/exe/RCC/shader source into ZEarth
decompile or bypass protected program components
reproduce Google's branded imagery or paid services without license
mark mock source checks as native Windows runtime parity
execution_contract.handoff: Create role-specific evidence appendix with source links, uncertainty and concrete independent implementation requirements; security/licensing review before source write; perform test-to-code readback with feature IDs.
